name: speech
description: Text-to-speech narration. The narrate skill turns a script into narration.wav plus words.json, a start and end time for every word. The default kokoro backend runs Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0) locally through onnxruntime, with timings from the model's own durations. The optional elevenlabs backend sends the text to the third-party ElevenLabs API, keyed by ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, after showing a character, host and cost estimate; an organization can forbid it. espeak-ng (GPL-3.0) is installed by you, never by the plugin. A SessionStart hook installs the locked Python packages, setup downloads the pinned model files, and check reports each missing prerequisite.
